query:
UPDATE attendance_weekly SET cancelled = 1 WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (4, 5) AND campus IN ('Canton', 'Jasper');
SELECT campus, weekNumber, weekStartDate, cancelled, SUM(headcount) as total_headcount FROM attendance_weekly WHERE year = 2026 AND weekNumber IN (4, 5) GROUP BY campus, weekNumber, weekStartDate, cancelled;
